baseline_sop.three_points: within 5 minutes before opening; nvidia-smi free/util x3 + compute-apps raw/filtered + build processes

baseline_sop.inherited_exception: none: the capture-window authoring-only util<60 exception is NOT inherited
baseline_sop.on_shortfall: defer the window; never relax the threshold

window_order: tree clean + build processes 0 + cargo test --no-run EXIT=0
three-point baseline re-sample and manual signed-floor check
regular monitor 60/60 at util<40 (PowerShell 5.1, no exception)
window_build_rule: after the freeze only the --features cuda-probe profile may build/run; default-feature builds inside the window are forbidden

signature.coverage: this window plan (v1) + the 3-point baseline re-sampled within 5 minutes before opening
signature.note: the sign block in materials/window-plan.txt section 8 is filled at sign time

not_claimed: L v1 scope is per-world geom poses only; per-world light poses deferred to L v2/K
